headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 25, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Mitch Keller earning the win. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Pirates' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs. In other action, the Detroit Tigers took down the Baltimore Orioles 4-1, with Troy Melton earning the win, and the Minnesota Twins edged out the Boston Red Sox in a close game, securing a 6-5 win.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Cole Winn of the Texas Rangers, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right arm fatigue. Other players on the injured list include Jake Irvin of the Washington Nationals, Edward Cabrera of the Chicago Cubs, Jonny DeLuca of the Tampa Bay Rays, Brant Hurter of the Detroit Tigers, Lourdes Gurriel Jr. of the Arizona Diamondbacks, Carter Baumler of the Texas Rangers, and Jordan Hicks of the Chicago White Sox.

The Philadelphia Phillies made a roster move ahead of Sunday's game, trading RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies in exchange for future considerations and international bonus pool money.
